hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
:: Get timestamp using PowerShell for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmm"') do set TIMESTAMP=%%I
:: Get last git commit for /f %%I in ('git rev-parse --short HEAD') do set COMMIT=%%I
:: Get build number from Jenkins set BUILD_NUM=%BUILD_NUMBER%
:: Set paths set BUILDS_DIR=%JENKINS_HOME%\..\builds\CIQ_PROCESSOR set DEST=%BUILDS_DIR%\%TIMESTAMP%_%COMMIT%
:: Create builds directory if not exists if not exist "%BUILDS_DIR%" mkdir "%BUILDS_DIR%"
:: Create new build folder and copy JAR mkdir "%DEST%" copy "%WORKSPACE%\target\*.jar" "%DEST%\"
:: Write info file echo Build Time : %TIMESTAMP% > "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Commit : %COMMIT% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Branch : %GIT_BRANCH% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Job : %JOB_NAME% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Build Number: %BUILD_NUM% >> "%DEST%\info.txt"
:: Keep only last 10 builds powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%BUILDS_DIR%' -Directory | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -SkipLast 10 | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'Deleted old build:' $_.Name }"
echo Done! Build copied to %DEST%
